sources.title: Piracy monthly report March 2025
sources.text: While underway, four perpetrators were sighted at the vessel stern area and a small boat was spotted on the starboard quarter of the ship. The master immediately raised the general alarm was raised and ordered a thorough search on board, with no further sighting of the perpetrators. Nothing was stolen and the crew was not injured. The incident was reported to Singapore VTIS. Safety broadcast on anti-piracy watch was initiated to warn all vessels to maintain a vigilant watch at all times in the SS. The RSN’s MSTF and Singapore PCG were notified of the incident.
